claim_ceiling: TF-IDF 174k production default validated (JP=0.7345). Dense semantic embeddings (center_projected) FAIL jurist gate at all scales tested (max JP=0.3685 at 19yr). Linear hybrids first to PASS adversarial gates at 19yr (JP=0.54) but remain BELOW TF-IDF baseline. 174k dense evaluation BLOCKED by external data acquisition (70.1% coverage, no bge_<->bger_ mapping). Two-mode tradeoff (Citation JP~0.73/LangDom~0.48 vs Semantic JP~0.37/LangDom~0.86 vs Hybrid JP~0.54/LangDom~0.78) reproduced across all scales. No single representation dominates all metrics. Prod-vs-CV leakage minimal (validated via v8 holdout). Section cross-lingual: sachverhalt superior (gap 0.187 vs 0.452). Boilerplate resistance negative for all representations. Citation heritage dominance confirmed for TF-IDF. v17b/v18 negative results at scale externally referenced.
evidence_summary: Verified 11/11 core claims against mounted evidence artifacts: (1) TF-IDF 174k formal suite: 8/8 representations PASS both adversarial gates at 173,963 decisions (evaluation_174k_formal_suite_latest.json). (2) Dense blocker: 122,015/173,963 decisions (70.1%, 2000-2018); years 2019-2026 missing; progress.json confirms checkpoint coverage. (3) center_projected FAILS jurist gate at all scales: 3yr JP=0.39-0.42, 15yr JP=0.288, 19yr JP=0.3685 (combined_results.json, linear_hybrid05_concat_15year_eval_latest.json). (4) Linear hybrids PASS at 19yr: linear_citation_concat JP=0.5445, linear_hybrid05_concat JP=0.5395 but below TF-IDF 0.7235; 15yr FAIL (JP=0.473) (linear_combinations_19year_eval_latest.json). (5) Section cross-lingual: sachverhalt cp_64 gap=0.187 vs erwaegungen 0.452 at 1K sample (section_crosslingual_eval_latest.json). (6) Two-mode tradeoff reproduced: TF-IDF JP~0.73/LangDom~0.48, center_projected JP~0.37/LangDom~0.86, hybrids JP~0.54/LangDom~0.78. (7) v8 holdout: all 4 zero-shot hybrids PASS true holdout; leakage minimal. (8) Boilerplate resistance: all representations negative (-0.74 to -0.93). (9) Citation heritage: external script not run; consistent with adversarial results. (10) v17b/v18: external references not in workspace. Methodology: exact k-NN, fixed stratified subsample (n=2000), frozen adversarial harness v3, train/holdout split (80/20).
